visualCharacteristics.purpose: Tabs: a row of tab labels that switches between panels
visualCharacteristics.layout: Horizontal tab list above one visible panel. Option underline: JLL style, left-aligned 16px labels on a thin grey rule with a blue active underline; panel text left and image right from 900px.

contentPattern.description: Tab labels with one panel each (text, list, CTA, optional image).
contentPattern.structure: One row per tab: cell 1 tab label; cell 2 panel content (paragraphs, lists, links, an optional image). Alternatively leave the block empty and follow it with sections that carry section metadata Tab ID and Tab Title (section-based tabs).
contentPattern.notes: Option underline: JLL tabbedinformation look; a panel image is shown beside the text from 900px. Put the tabs heading (H2) as default content before the block.

reuseGuidance: Use for switchable panels of text and media. Use tabs-stacked for the grid of full-width triggers (homepage accordion-carousel).
